# Compliance Project Manager

Financial Crime & Compliance - London, UK - Hybrid - Full Time

Overview

Application Form

****Compliance Project Manager****

****Location: London****  
****Hybrid working with up to two remote working days per week****

We are an energetic and collaborative MLRO team operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly and no two days are the same. The team handles a broad range of cases and queries from across the business, while ensuring that we continue to meet our regulatory obligations. As 3S Money grows, we are expanding the team to support increasing volumes of escalations and to work closely with colleagues across our different jurisdictions. This role requires strong attention to detail, a proactive approach, and confidence in communicating with stakeholders at all levels. As Project Manager, you will support the MLRO team by managing projects that require compliance input, helping to bridge the gap between the MLRO function and wider business teams, and contributing to broader compliance activities alongside ad hoc tasks as required.

****Our mission**** 

3S Money is reinventing international business payments. Founded in 2018, our mission is to help growing businesses to send, receive and exchange money in over 190 countries. With offices in five countries and over 200 employees, you’ll be joining a high-energy, high-impact team that’s achieved profitability and has a wealth of opportunity ahead. 

****Our culture**** 

At 3S Money, we believe in caring personally, staying curious and making an impact through collaboration not competition. Our culture is genuinely transparent with minimal hierarchy and a commitment to each employee’s professional growth. 

****What you’ll be doing****

·       Manage Compliance and Financial Crime projects from initial planning through to implementation and completion.

·       Develop clear project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables and ownership of actions.

·       Coordinate project delivery across Compliance and other relevant teams.

·       Support the delivery and ongoing management of the Compliance Monitoring Programme (CMP), including coordinating reviews, tracking actions and monitoring deadlines.

·       Monitor project progress and manage risks, issues, dependencies and delays.

·       Provide regular and accurate project updates to the MLRO and relevant governance committees.

·       Support projects arising from regulatory changes, audits, risk assessments, compliance monitoring and regulatory reviews.

·       Ensure regulatory requirements and compliance controls are appropriately incorporated into project delivery.

·       Maintain complete project documentation, decision records and supporting evidence.

·       Coordinate testing, implementation and staff training.

·       Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, strengthen controls and reduce manual work through technology and automation.

·       Work with Compliance subject-matter experts to ensure solutions meet regulatory and operational requirements.

·       Escalate material risks, delays and decisions to the MLRO promptly.

****About you, you have****

·       The successful candidate must have demonstrable experience managing projects and delivering change within a Compliance, Financial Crime or wider regulated environment

·       Are a fast and strategic thinker, resourceful and deliver on time; with the ability to work independently.

·       Strong experience with record-keeping, training and working with stakeholders.

·       Great written & verbal communication skills to share your knowledge across the business at all levels.

****In return for your hard work:****

****💰**** Competitive Salary + plus stock options (after 12 months) & benefits

💻 Hybrid working setup in our wonderful city-centre office

📚 We foster non-BAU projects in our team, we want you to explore new avenues and expand your expertise to benefit your professional pathway & our teams.

➕ And much, much more....

****Our commitment to you****

We are an equal opportunities employer.

We make recruitment decisions based on your skills, experience and ability to contribute. We’re building services for everyone and believe a diverse team helps us create better products, make better decisions and build an inclusive workplace.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and discover the 3S way.

**About Abound**

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over **£1.3bn** in loans directly to customers while delivering **market-leading credit performance** - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by **£2bn+** of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

## About the role

We're expanding access to affordable credit by launching credit products that make a real difference to customers. We move quickly, often with leading fintech, consumer and e-commerce companies, so that we can offer affordable credit at the right point in the customer journey. We work in a highly regulated environment, so our products have to work end to end from day one: technically, operationally and commercially.

As a Product Associate, you'll work across product, data and commercials. You'll dig into how our products perform, from funnel conversion to loan-level unit economics, and turn what you find into ideas for how we scale, improve margins and grow. You'll work hands-on with data and code, alongside Product Managers, Engineering, Credit and Operations. You'll help decide where the product goes next, as well as how we ship it.

This role is for top-tier STEM or Economics graduates who think like analysts, build like engineers and care about the P&L like owners, and who want to progress to Product Manager at a fast-growing, industry-leading fintech.

## What you'll be doing

**Product analytics & insight**

* Own analysis of product performance across the full funnel: traffic, applications, approvals, conversion, originations, repayment and credit outcomes
* Build and maintain the dashboards, metrics and data models that Product, Credit and Operations rely on
* Form sharp hypotheses, design experiments (journey changes, pricing, A/B tests) and measure the impact rigorously
* Get to the root cause of anomalies quickly, whether the cause is in the data, the code or the customer journey

**Unit economics & commercial thinking**

* Model the economics of each product: acquisition cost, approval and take-up rates, pricing, funding cost, expected loss, servicing cost and lifetime value
* Put numbers on the trade-offs behind product decisions, such as wider approval versus higher losses, or partner revenue share versus volume
* Track contribution margin and cohort profitability by product, channel and partner, and show where we make or lose money

**Growth & product strategy**

* Come up with ideas for scaling and growing from where we are today (new segments, channels, products and pricing) and estimate what each one is worth
* Look across our products and partnerships for places where they reinforce each other: cross-sell, top-ups, repeat lending, shared customers and shared data
* Help evaluate new partner opportunities and build the business case, covering volume, economics, integration effort and risk
* Turn the strongest ideas into clear proposals and see them through to launch

**Building & shipping**

* Use AI coding tools to build and ship product end to end, across both front-end and back-end, from quick prototypes to features that go live
* Build internal tools, automations and data workflows that remove manual work and help the team move faster
* Be proficient with our analytics stack: build dashboards in AWS QuickSight and track funnels, events and experiments in PostHog
* Use SQL and Python every day to pull, model and analyse data
* Learn how our APIs, decisioning flows and data pipelines work, and work directly with engineers on specs, testing and release validation
* Support Product Managers with discovery, delivery and partner onboarding

**Launch readiness & operations**

* Define success criteria for each launch and the metrics that show whether it's working
* Design test scenarios, including edge cases and failure modes, and test the end-to-end customer journey before release
* Work closely with QA to make sure production releases are stable
* Monitor production performance after release, and pick up and triage related bugs with engineering
* Make sure new products and journeys work at launch for customer support, collections and complaints teams
* Use operational data to spot recurring issues, fix them at the source and make sure they're closed out, not just discussed

## Who you are

* A top-tier STEM or Economics graduate (computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, economics or similar)
* 0–2 years of experience, including internships, placements or early-career roles with real responsibility
* Strongly analytical and confident with SQL and Python, able to go from raw data to a clear recommendation
* Able to build with AI. You use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to ship working front-end and back-end code, and you've built things, whether side projects, hackathons, internal tools or production apps
* Hands-on with analytics tools such as AWS QuickSight, PostHog or similar BI and product analytics platforms
* Commercially minded. You naturally ask how something makes money, and you enjoy modelling unit economics, pricing and P&L
* Strong product sense. You have opinions on the products you use, why they work and how they could grow
* A structured problem-solver who can break down messy, real-world problems
* A clear communicator who can walk an engineer through a model and make a recommendation to leadership

*Nice to have:* an interest in consumer credit, lending, payments or fintech; experience with experimentation and statistics.

## How you work (and what we value)

* You think like an owner, of both the customer outcome and the commercial outcome
* You'd rather build a quick prototype or run the numbers than debate in the abstract
* You follow through until problems are actually solved
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't wait for perfect instructions
* You speak up when something doesn't make sense, and you help fix it
* You put in extra effort at key moments, such as launches and live incidents, knowing that's where the real learning happens

## Progression & growth

This role is a stepping stone to Product Management, with a clear progression path. As a Product Associate, you'll be expected to:

* Build deep knowledge of our products, data and commercials
* Consistently own problems end to end and deliver measurable business and customer impact
* Show strong judgement, data-driven thinking and stakeholder management

High performers will progress to Junior Product Manager as they begin to:

* Own a product area or metric independently, including its commercial performance
* Lead defined workstreams within launches or partner integrations
* Originate growth ideas that make it onto the roadmap and deliver results

Progression is based on impact and ownership, not time served.

## What we offer

* Everyone owns a piece of the company: equity
* Hybrid working, with 3 days a week in the office
* 25 days' holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays
* 2 paid volunteering days per year
* One month's paid sabbatical after 4 years
* Employee loan

* Team wellness budget to be active together: set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

# Product Lead

## Location

London

## Address

London, London

Full time

OverviewApplication

**About Abound**

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over **£1.3bn** in loans directly to customers while delivering **market-leading credit performance** - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by **£2bn+** of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen.

This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off.

We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you.

Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete.

The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how.

**What you'll be doing**

* Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality.

* Lead how we quote and present offers across aggregator and price-comparison marketplaces, optimising eligibility, risk-based pricing and offer presentation to win the right customers at the point of acquisition.

* Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book.

* Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk we do not.

* Work with data science to make sure our credit models are calibrated and tuned for this population rather than inherited unchanged from prime or adjacent segments, and be able to get into the data yourself when needed.

* Use credit and commercial insight to optimise unit economics, balancing approval rates, pricing, loss rates and volume so the product scales profitably.

* Monitor product and portfolio performance across the customer lifecycle, spotting emerging trends, risks and opportunities early.

* Shape underwriting strategy, segmentation, credit policy and decisioning logic in partnership with risk and data science.

* Design and evaluate experiments and strategy changes, and turn the analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

* Own the management information for the segment: define the metrics, monitoring and reporting that let the business make consistent decisions about the product.

* Assess new initiatives, customer segments and product changes with both a commercial and a credit lens.

* Present clear, structured updates on product performance to senior leadership and governance forums, and support funding and due diligence conversations where the product is in focus.

**Who you are**

* A product person at heart: you care about the customer, the journey and the commercial outcome, and you want to own something end to end.

* Quantitative and hands-on. You are comfortable in SQL and Python (or similar), you can interrogate a dataset yourself, and you can hold your own in a conversation with data scientists about model performance and calibration.

* Credit-literate. You understand how eligibility, pricing and underwriting decisions shape the book you end up with, and you have a working understanding of adverse selection and why it matters in marketplace lending.

* Commercially sharp, with a solid grasp of unit economics and a clear understanding that product decisions in lending have to work for both growth and portfolio performance.

* Curious about trade-offs rather than defensive about them: alert to the fact that deeper affordability assessment can hurt conversion, and motivated by the challenge of capturing its value without sacrificing growth.

* Able to move between detail and direction: happy getting into the data on a Tuesday and shaping the roadmap on a Wednesday.

* Confident challenging assumptions and turning analysis into practical action, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to people who are not analysts.

* Collaborative and credible with risk, commercial, engineering and data science teams.

* Structured, proactive and comfortable in a scaling environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected.

**Experience and background**

* Around four to five years of experience in product, credit strategy, analytics or a closely related role within consumer lending or fintech. We are deliberately targeting this level: this is a step-up role for someone ready to own a product, not a lateral move for someone who has run several.

* Experience in unsecured consumer lending, ideally Unsecured Personal Loans (UPL), with exposure to the mechanics of acquiring customers through price-comparison or aggregator marketplaces. Direct experience in higher-APR or near-prime lending is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

* Hands-on data skills: SQL as a minimum, and ideally Python or R for analysis. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to work alongside them as a peer and do your own analysis.

* Experience working with or alongside credit decisioning, scorecards or risk models, and an understanding of how they are built, monitored and adjusted for a specific population.

* Some experience of pricing, eligibility or offer design, and of using experiments or A/B tests to evaluate changes.

* A track record of using analysis to influence decisions, not just to report on outcomes, in a role where you had some accountability for commercial results.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.

* Experience with Open Banking data or cashflow underwriting is a plus, as is experience in a fast-growing fintech.

## **About the Role**

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Technical Product Manager, AI Systems, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions.

## **What You'll Own**

* Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience.
* Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions.
* Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX.
* Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration.
* Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback.
* Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences.
* Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment.
* Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully.
* Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust.

## **What We're Looking For**

## **Technical**

* Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills.
* Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production.
* Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers.
* Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes.

## **Product & AI**

* Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems.
* Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration.
* Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans.
* Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious.

## **Mindset**

* Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep.
* Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage.
* Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration.
* Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment.

## **Nice to have**

* Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.
* Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.
* Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.
* Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.
* Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both **AI systems and product outcomes**.

## **Outcomes**

* Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.
* AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.
* Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.
* Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.
* Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

## **How We Work**

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers and product leaders have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

## **Interview process**

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

**Your Mission**

Call of Duty is one of the most iconic and successful video game franchises in the world, delivering unforgettable experiences to millions of players every day. At the heart of that experience is **fair play**, and that is where the **Ricochet Anti-Cheat** team comes in.

  

Our mission is to protect the integrity of the online experience, ensuring every player enjoys a level playing field. As a Data Scientist on Ricochet, you will analyze, investigate, and translate complex data into insights that help detect, prevent, and respond to cheating across Call of Duty live titles.

  

This role can be based in either our Sherman Oaks, CA or our Vancouver, BC office and follows an onsite work schedule of four days per week. Work arrangements may change at the company's discretion to meet business needs.

  

**The Role**

We are seeking a Data Scientist to help secure the Call of Duty franchise by producing structured insights, experiments, and analyses that improve Ricochet anti-cheat outcomes at scale.

  

In this role, you will partner with anti-cheat engineers, analysts, operations specialists, game designers, and producers to answer ambiguous questions, evaluate detections, measure model impact, and identify new opportunities for anti-cheat initiatives. You will support the broader Ricochet organization through consultation, data analysis, data engineering, experimentation, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.

  

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong statistical and data science fundamentals with curiosity about adversarial player behavior, a passion for competitive integrity, and the communication skills to make complex findings actionable for technical and non-technical partners.

**What you bring to the table**

* Analyze gameplay telemetry, enforcement data, behavioral signals, and other large-scale datasets to investigate cheating patterns and anti-cheat outcomes.
* Collaborate on the ETL, data analysis, and measurement strategy for machine-learning projects that enhance detection, prevention, and response to cheating.
* Design and execute experiments and analyses that measure the impact of models, detections, interventions, and enforcement workflows on players and the business.
* Answer ambiguous questions with practical, evidence-based recommendations that help Ricochet prioritize anti-cheat initiatives.
* Produce dashboards, recurring reports, and executive-level summaries that clearly communicate results, trends, impediments, and impact.
* Partner with game designers, engineers, producers, analysts, and operations teams to identify new opportunities for anti-cheat improvements.
* Support validation of new anti-cheat detections and model changes before broader deployment, with attention to effectiveness and false-positive risk.
* Help improve the quality, consistency, and transparency of anti-cheat data pipelines, metrics, analysis standards, and reporting practices.
* Stay current on advances in anti-cheat technology, statistical analysis, experimentation, data science, and adversarial behavior analysis.
* Learn from senior team members, share knowledge with peers, and contribute to a culture of fairness, accountability, and continuous improvement in game security.

Experience

* Experience building or maintaining dashboards, reports, and repeatable analytical workflows for stakeholders.

**Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.**

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

## About the Role

Adaptyv is opening a London lab in 2026. You will be the first lab operations hire on the ground and will help take the site from an empty shell to a fully operational, high-throughput protein engineering lab.

The lab will run production work for partners such as Anthropic and Boltz alongside a wide range of R&D projects, and give UK biotech companies access to protein production and characterisation at scale.

You will own the operational build-out of the lab: fit-out, instrument installation, infrastructure, supply chain, maintenance, safety, compliance, and the lab operations team. The Lausanne team has already built and runs this setup today, so you will have proven systems and playbooks to work from. Your job is to adapt them to London and make the new site work at the same standard.

Once the lab is live, you will run day-to-day lab operations and continuously improve its reliability, capacity, and throughput.

* **Lead the lab fit-out.** Own the operational side of taking the space from shell to working laboratory, including benching, ventilation, power, cold storage, extraction, safety systems, contractors, timelines, and readiness.
* **Install and commission the instrument fleet.** Coordinate delivery, installation, qualification, and handover of equipment including array-SPR, BLI, and liquid handlers, working closely with vendors and our automation team in Lausanne.
* **Build the lab operating infrastructure.** Put in place inventory and procurement, shipping and cold chain, maintenance schedules, service contracts, chemical handling, waste management, and the other systems required to keep a high-throughput lab running reliably.
* **Own lab safety and compliance.** Establish the processes, documentation, risk assessments, notifications, and permits required to operate the London site safely and compliantly.
* **Build the lab operations team.** Hire and manage the people responsible for keeping the facility, equipment, logistics, and day-to-day laboratory operations running smoothly.
* **Run the lab.** Once production starts, own the operational performance of the site: uptime, throughput, inventory, maintenance, safety, and continuous improvement.

## What We're Looking For

* **You have built or expanded a laboratory before.** You have led a fit-out, site move, major equipment installation, or new laboratory launch. Experience running an established lab is valuable, but we are specifically looking for someone who has helped build one.
* **You have deep hands-on lab operations experience.** Ideally in a high-throughput, automation-heavy biotech, life-science, or similarly technical environment.
* **You have a strong life-sciences background.** A degree and/or significant professional experience in biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field is highly preferred. * **You are strong with vendors and contractors.** You are comfortable managing instrument manufacturers, service engineers, contractors, suppliers, and logistics providers, and keeping complex installation and operational work on track.
* **You are highly operational.** You build systems, spot problems early, keep track of details, and make sure the lab continues to function as complexity and throughput increase.
* **You are comfortable working at startup pace.** Priorities move quickly, the team is small, and there will not always be a predefined process for every problem.
* **You use AI as part of how you work.** We use tools like Claude Code and our own software throughout Adaptyv, including in lab operations. We expect you to be comfortable using AI to move faster and improve how work gets done.
* **You are in London.** This is an on-site role. You are already based there or ready to move.

## Description

### The Role

We are looking for an experienced Photonics Engineer to join our team developing and testing the photonic hardware for Aegiq's next-generation quantum computing systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will design, build and develop advanced optical test systems, working across free-space and fibre optics, photonic integrated circuits and cryogenic technologies. You will take ownership of experimental setups, from initial design and assembly through to calibration, characterisation, automation and troubleshooting.

Working alongside our scientists and engineers, you will help translate experimental results into improvements in device performance and system design. You'll have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, develop new measurement capabilities and contribute directly to the development of our quantum computing hardware.

### What You'll Be Doing

* **Optical Test Systems:** Design, build, align and maintain free-space and fibre-based optical systems for testing photonic devices and components.
* **Cryogenic Characterisation:** Plan and carry out measurements using cryogenic systems, including sample preparation, optical and electrical interfacing, thermal cycling and troubleshooting.
* **Device Characterisation:** Develop and perform measurements of optical and electro-optical performance, including transmission, loss, coupling efficiency, spectra, linewidth, polarisation and timing characteristics.
* **PIC Testing:** Develop reliable and repeatable methods for characterising photonic integrated circuits at room and cryogenic temperatures, using appropriate optical coupling and probing techniques.
* **Measurement Automation:** Develop Python-based measurement routines and instrument-control systems to improve test efficiency, repeatability and data quality.
* **Data Analysis:** Analyse experimental results, assess measurement uncertainty, identify performance limitations and communicate findings and recommendations to the wider engineering team.
* **Laboratory Development:** Take responsibility for test equipment, calibration, operating procedures and safe working practices, helping improve our laboratory capabilities as the company grows.

In 2025, we delivered our first-generation quantum computer to the UK's National Quantum Computing Centre. We're now developing our second-generation platform and expanding our team to tackle the scientific and engineering challenges involved in building quantum computers at scale.

We're a growing team of scientists, engineers and specialists who enjoy solving difficult problems and turning new ideas into working technology. At Aegiq, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, contribute directly to the technology we're developing and help shape the future of the company.

Position Summary 

The College Park Facilities Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe, compliant, reliable and efficient operation of site facilities and Facilities Management services within a cGMP pharmaceutical environment. # Business Development Lead

We usually respond within a week

If you want to run the outbound engine that fills our pipeline, lead a team of BDRs who live on the phone, and own the number that turns into revenue, come join us!

Our AI SDRs handle inbound end to end, from speed-to-lead to qualification. That leaves our BDRs free to do one thing: outbound. Finding the hospitality and retail brands that aren't looking for us yet, and starting the conversation.

Outbound already works for us in the UK and Germany. Now it needs to run as a machine.

We need the person who owns it. Who decides which accounts we go after, in what order, through which channel and with which message. Then measures it, and makes it better every week.

If you want to be the person who leads business development at All Gravy, keep reading!

##### 🥞 **The mission**

All Gravy is the frontline operating system. One platform for comms, learning, engagement, operations and scheduling, with built-in AI. Think WhatsApp meets Duolingo meets Claude for frontline workers. Used daily by 350+ brands like GAIL's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, 7-Eleven and Honest Burgers.

We're growing 3x year-over-year across the UK, the Nordics and Germany, where revenue has grown 12x since the start of the year.

##### 🎯 **The role**

You lead our outbound BDR team and own outbound-sourced pipeline: meetings that turn into opportunities, opportunities that turn into revenue, and that our AEs are glad to take.

You lead from the front. You coach, you build the system, and you still pick up the phone.

##### ⚙️ **What you get from day one**

We invested in RevOps and sales tooling far earlier than most companies our size do. You get to run business development on top of it:

* Lead lists that build themselves. Accounts are sourced, enriched and assigned to reps automatically, so nobody spends their morning in a spreadsheet.
* A daily dial deck. Every BDR starts the day with researched accounts and call cards ready, and call outcomes flow back into HubSpot on their own.
* Hyperbound for practice. BDRs rehearse cold calls, openers and objection handling against AI buyer personas modelled on our ICP, scored against our own scorecards, before they dial a real lead.
* Every call captured. Attention records and scores real calls, so you coach from what was said.
* Inbound off your plate. AI SDRs handle every inbound lead, so your team spends all its time on outbound.
* Reporting you can trust. HubSpot on a Snowflake data layer, with live funnel, pipeline and rep scorecards.
* A playbook the system runs. Qualification, handoffs and deal stages live in our own GTM Suite. When we change the process, we ship an update.

##### 🔥 **What you'll do**

* Own pipeline generation. Set outbound pipeline targets with sales leadership, hit them, and know exactly which segments, markets and plays deliver.
* Lead and coach the BDR team. Hire, run call reviews, listen in live, and build Hyperbound roleplays for the objections your team keeps losing on. Develop BDRs into AEs. That's how many of ours got there.
* Use AI where it helps. Agents do the research and personalisation. Your BDRs do the conversations. You decide where that line sits.
* Sharpen targeted outbound. The lists are there. You decide which segments and markets to push, design the plays across phone, email and LinkedIn, and kill what doesn't work fast.
* Own outbound conversion. Connect rate, meeting rate, show rate, meeting-to-opportunity. You know where the funnel leaks and you fix it.
* Work hand in hand with marketing. Tell them which messages and segments land on the phone, and turn events and campaigns into outbound plays.
* Still dial. You show the team how it's done, and you enjoy it.

##### 🧠 **Who you are**

* You've led BDRs. 4+ years in B2B SaaS business development, with at least 1-2 years as a team lead.
* You beat your pipeline targets. And you can show us the numbers.
* Cold calling is still your thing. You'd never ask your team to do something you won't.
* You think in systems. You design the process, the sequences and the reporting. You've built in HubSpot or similar and know your way around Clay, Apollo and the rest.
* You're AI-first. You use Claude or similar every day for research, personalisation and analysis. You see agents as part of your team, not a threat to it.
* You make people better. Your BDRs improve every week because you coach them every week, and you make practice a daily habit instead of a quarterly workshop.
* Excellent English. German is a big plus, as we're scaling DACH fast. Danish, Swedish or Norwegian is a plus too.

##### 🚩 **Probably not for you if**

* You want to manage people but stopped dialling a while ago.
* You measure success in calls and emails sent.
* You'd rather build your own tooling from scratch than get the most out of a stack that's already running.
* You see AI as a threat to the BDR role. We think it changes the role, and we want someone excited to define what comes next.

##### 📈 **Where this goes**

3 months: You know the funnel end to end, your targets are set, every BDR practises in Hyperbound daily, and your first outbound plays by segment and market are live.

6 months: The team hits its pipeline target month after month. Meeting-to-opportunity conversion is up, and you know exactly which plays to scale in each market.

Beyond: As we expand into new markets, you build out the function, toward Head of Business Development.

##### 💎 **Why All Gravy**

1. Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.
2. A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment.
3. Work that matters. Your work directly affects the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.
4. People who've done it before. Ex-founders and operators who've built, scaled and won, and want to do it again, bigger.
5. The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. Competitive salary and warrant package.

##### **📍 Practical**

* Hybrid.
* Full-time.
* You report to Malek, our Sales Director, and work closely with our AEs, marketing and RevOps.

# Business Development Manager – Hybrid with UK-wide travel

**Reports to: Operations Director (matrix reporting to the Group Chief Commercial Officer)**

We have an exciting opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join Proactive, a leading private prosthetics and orthotics provider.

For more than 25 years, Proactive has helped people reclaim their independence through exceptional prosthetic, orthotic and rehabilitation care, shaped by genuine compassion, clinical expertise and our promise of patient-crafted care.

Over the past three years we have grown significantly, expanding to five clinics across the UK. This growth has created an opportunity for a driven, relationship-focused Business Development Manager to join our team and help shape the next stage of our journey.

Proactive is part of AM Healthcare Group (AMHG), a market-leading international healthcare products and services provider. AMHG operates primarily in areas that enhance mobility and accessibility, including orthotics, prosthetics and wheelchairs. It has more than 60 sites across the UK and Ireland, as well as operations in France, the Netherlands and Sweden, and employs more than 700 staff.

### **Job role summary**

Proactive mainly treats patients going through personal injury claims after a traumatic accident or limb loss. Our patients are referred to us by the case manager, solicitor or insurer who is supporting the patient through their ongoing claim.

Due to our expansion we are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to drive our growth across private, medico-legal and third-sector markets. You’ll build a strong referral pipeline, widening our existing referrer network, developing new partnerships and strengthening existing relationships with case managers, solicitors, insurers, private healthcare providers and healthcare professionals. You’ll be the main point of contact for new prospective clients and partners, and you’ll raise awareness of Proactive’s services across the regions we serve. Working closely with our clinical and leadership teams, you’ll turn opportunities into lasting partnerships that help more people access our gold-standard prosthetic and orthotic services.

Having grown to five clinics, we now need someone to bring structure and coordination to our new-business activity. You’ll build and manage a single pipeline across the group of clinics, making sure every lead is followed through to conversion, helping Proactive grow as one integrated organisation rather than five clinics working independently. Success will be measured by growth in referral volumes and revenue, pipeline conversion, and customer retention and satisfaction.

This is a role you’ll have the freedom to shape. We need someone with the experience to tailor the approach to our industry and existing referrers, while always looking for new ways to grow.

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial drive with a genuine passion for improving people’s lives: someone who builds trust easily, thinks strategically, and thrives in a fast-paced environment while supporting exceptional patient care.

### **Responsibilities & Tasks:**

**Business development & growth**

* Develop and deliver a business development strategy that links all five clinics and supports Proactive’s growth objectives.
* Identify, develop and secure new business across private, medico-legal and third-sector markets.
* Work with each Clinic Manager to create a tailored new-business plan based on the opportunities and growth needs in their region.
* Build and manage a single, group-wide pipeline, progressing every lead through to conversion and accurately forecasting future business.
* Attend networking and educational events, including evening events such as solicitor and barrister training days and evening socials, to build relationships with potential referrers, working alongside the clinical team where relevant.
* Turn new contacts into live leads, follow-up presentations and an ongoing pipeline of activity.
* Work with the operational and clinical teams to develop innovative service solutions that meet client needs.

**Relationships & account management**

* Act as the main point of contact for new prospective clients and partners, involving relevant Clinic Managers throughout.
* Work with the Clinical Director and Clinic Managers to deliver tailored presentations to potential referrers, including insurers, solicitors and case managers.
* Understand what our clients need and clearly explain how our clinical services meet those needs.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing referrers to support retention and organic growth.
* Gather client feedback and engage proactively to keep customer satisfaction high.
* Analyse referrer trends so that engagement matches each referrer’s level of activity.
* Develop and manage our CRM system, keeping customer records accurate and up to date.

**Market insight & reporting**

* Monitor market trends, procurement activity, and partner and competitor services to stay ahead of new developments and shifts in competitor strategy.
* Build a deep understanding of the private prosthetic and orthotic market to drive strong growth within our existing referrer network.
* Provide market intelligence and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Report monthly and quarterly on performance, pipeline activity and market opportunities to the Proactive Leadership Team and Group SLT.

**Marketing & internal collaboration**

* Hold regular reviews with the marketing and support teams to keep Proactive’s marketing strategy fresh, effective and competitive.
* Support the development of marketing materials, case studies and promotional campaigns.
* Contribute to strategic planning and wider growth initiatives.
* Treat internal communications confidentially where appropriate.

### **Experience & Skills:**

**Essential experience**

* Experience of working in or with the private trauma or personal injury market.
* Understanding of medico-legal referrals, personal injury insurance claims, and the legal and funding processes involved.
* Experience of working with solicitors, case managers and insurers.
* A proven track record in business development, sales or account management, including winning new business and securing contracts.
* Experience of developing and managing strategic relationships in healthcare settings.
* Strong commercial and financial awareness, with a good understanding of healthcare, medico-legal and private rehabilitation markets.

**Desirable experience**

* Knowledge of private prosthetic, orthotic or rehabilitation providers.

### **Skills & attributes**

* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills, with the confidence to present to groups and individuals.
* Builds and maintains strong working relationships, both internally and externally.
* Able to analyse market data and identify business opportunities.
* Self-motivated and results-driven, with a positive, proactive “can-do” attitude.
* A strategic thinker who is resilient and adaptable in a changing healthcare environment.
* Highly organised, with strong project management skills and the ability to plan, prioritise and manage competing demands.
* Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Diplomatic, but assertive when needed.
* Sound judgement and the ability to make quick, effective decisions in complex situations.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Professional and discreet when handling confidential information.
* Good literacy and numeracy.
* Confident using Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel) and CRM systems.

### **Working relationships:**

**Internal**

* Clinical Director of Proactive
* Operations Director of Proactive
* Proactive Clinic Managers
* Group Chief Commercial Officer, other members of the SLT
* Group Marketing Team

**External**

* Referrers: solicitors, case managers, insurers and private healthcare providers
* Potential preferred partners offering complementary services, e.g. physiotherapy and rehabilitation
* Market competitors

### **What do we offer**

* Competitive salary, dependent on experience
* Pension scheme
* Incremental holiday allowance of 33 days, rising to 38 days (inclusive of bank holidays)
* Innovative and collaborative working culture
* Refer-a-friend incentive scheme

You will work closely with in-house engineers and the wider Leidos cross-functional teams to ensure that the tools and equipment are designed to meet quality, efficiency, and safety standards. **Team Working/Leading**

* Within a design team, lead collaborate and innovate to create detailed tooling designs, including fixtures, jigs, clamps, and other specialized equipment required for manufacturing processes.

* Collate information for operation and maintenance manuals.
* Produce operation and maintenance manuals.
* Provide out of hours support as required.
* Technically leading and engagement with remote teams in UK and across the world.
* Ensuring no fault forward engineering output philosophy is strictly adhered to.

* Produce scheme drawings and layouts for evaluation against customer specifications.
* Produce 3D models.
* Produce detailed mechanical manufacturing drawings.
* Evaluate basic designs through power and stress calculations, and for cost effectiveness and ease of manufacture and maintenance.

* Work to Company procedures and specific instructions at all times.

**Time Management**

* Ensure that work is completed within the hours and deadlines agreed with the Engineering Manager / Techncial Lead.

## **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

## About the role

We are seeking an International Finance Program Manager to join our International Accounting team in Dublin at Anthropic. In this role, you will drive execution excellence across a diverse portfolio of international expansion initiatives, standing up new go-to-market and infrastructure entities. You will partner closely with the Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Payroll and Finance Systems leads, functional business owners, and cross-functional teams to ensure initiatives are well-governed, on track, and delivering measurable business value.

This role requires someone who can context-switch across multiple finance domains, establish lightweight but effective program management practices, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly. You will be instrumental in helping Anthropic scale its international footprint so that every new entity is ready to operate and meet its obligations from day one.

## Responsibilities

* **Program Management:** Manage a portfolio of international entity set-ups, ensuring clear prioritization, resource alignment, and delivery accountability across the Finance teams that own the deliverables
* **Governance & Process Design:** Establish and maintain lightweight governance frameworks appropriate for a fast-paced, engineering-centric culture, including standardized project intake, status reporting, risk management, and decision escalation processes
* **Status Tracking & Reporting:** Provide clear, consistent visibility into project health, milestones, dependencies, and risks through structured reporting to the Head of International Accounting, functional leads, and Finance leadership, and maintain the inventory of entities and the infrastructure expansion pipeline
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Lead cross-functional coordination across Finance Operations, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Systems, Legal and People Operations teams to drive alignment and remove blockers
* **Entity Set-up and Go-live Readiness:** Track the finance set-up of each new entity (bank accounts, tax registrations, intercompany agreements, bank mandates, payroll, Workday and the accounting systems) and its go-live readiness, through the first payroll, first month-end close and first payroll tax or VAT filing, in support of the finance owner
* **Compliance Coordination:** Partner with the Tax, Payroll and Accounting teams and local advisers to support the registrations, filings and compliance calendar of each new entity
* **Change Management:** Drive user adoption for new entity processes and controls through structured change management, including training, communication plans, and post-go-live support
* **Vendor Management:** Track and manage vendor delivery timelines, SOW commitments, and partner accountability across the banks and the payroll, tax and accounting providers in each country
* **AI Initiative Tracking:** Coordinate AI automation initiatives within the international expansion portfolio, tracking progress on Claude-powered use cases and ensuring integration with broader Finance roadmap

## Minimum Qualifications

* Have 10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or PMO roles, with at least 3 years working in finance or accounting
* Have hands-on experience managing complex entity set-ups, international expansion programs or multi-country roll-outs
* Can manage multiple concurrent workstreams across different finance domains without losing sight of the details or the big picture
* Are skilled at building trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders across Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal and People Operations teams
* Have experience designing and implementing governance frameworks that provide accountability without excessive overhead, particularly in fast-paced, agile environments
* Possess strong analytical skills and can synthesize complex project data into clear, executive-ready reporting
* Are proficient with modern project management tools (Asana, Jira, or similar) and entity management tools and can quickly establish portfolio-level visibility and dashboards
* Have excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex project information to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and can navigate ambiguity while maintaining focus on delivery and deadlines
* Are passionate about building scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth

## Preferred Qualifications

* Background in finance operations, accounting, or FP&A with understanding of month-end close, financial reporting, and compliance workflows
* Experience with change management frameworks and methodologies
* Experience working in high-growth technology companies
* A professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent)
* A project management qualification
* Interest in or experience with AI-powered automation and its application to finance processes

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

€170.000 - €220.000 EUR

## **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:**A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

## **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

## **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

job_title: Software Engineer - Private Cloud Compute, On-Device Client Frameworks
job_description:
The Private Cloud Compute (PCC) team builds Apple's privacy-preserving cloud
inference platform — the system that lets generative-AI features on iPhone,
iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro reach into the cloud without compromising user
privacy. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that builds the
on-device client side of that pipeline: the system frameworks and sandboxed
services that every Apple Intelligence and Foundation Models request flows
through before it ever leaves the device. This is system-level Apple platform
work. You will design and ship the Swift frameworks that turn high-level
inference requests into a compact wire protocol, manage long-lived connections,
stream multimodal output back to client apps - all under strict process
isolation and privacy guarantees. Your code will run on every device that uses
Apple Intelligence — and the bar for correctness, performance, and privacy is
set accordingly.


DESCRIPTION


You will be a key contributor to the Swift frameworks and XPC services that
connect on-device apps and system daemons to PCC. Day-to-day responsibilities
include: Designing and evolving the on-device client SDKs and the XPC services
they sit behind, balancing API ergonomics for client teams with the strict
process-isolation and attestation guarantees required by PCC. Implementing
high-throughput, low-latency request paths: protobuf serialization of inference
payloads, payload compression, multi-turn session state and lifecycle,
retry/cancellation semantics, and streaming of incremental model output back to
clients. Owning concurrency and resource management across async/await,
AsyncStream, and GCD — including correct cancellation, back-pressure, and
lifetime management of long-lived XPC connections. Building the telemetry,
signposts, and privacy-audited logging that let on-call engineers diagnose
request failures across device, cloud, and inference layers without exposing
user data. Collaborating closely with the PCC server-side, Foundation Models,
attestation, and platform-frameworks teams; writing design documents, leading
reviews, and mentoring engineers on Apple platform fundamentals. Profiling on
real hardware with Instruments and driving down memory, latency, and energy
costs in the request path — these libraries run on every device, on every
inference, so every microsecond matters.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Experience developing complex, system-level frameworks, daemons, or background
services for iOS and macOS (beyond standard UI-focused app development). Strong
programming proficiency in Swift, alongside experience with Objective-C or C/C++
for lower-level system integration. Deep understanding of concurrency (Swift
Concurrency, GCD), memory management, and asynchronous network programming.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Experience designing or evolving wire protocols (e.g., Protocol Buffers),
data-streaming pipelines, or connection management. Hands-on experience with
Apple's Inter-Process Communication (XPC) to bridge sandboxed applications and
system services. Familiarity with secure communication protocols, cryptography,
or privacy-preserving architectures. Working knowledge of ML concepts and
frameworks and proficiency in performance profiling with Instruments, and
experience implementing robust client-side telemetry and logging using native
Apple APIs. Familiarity with end-to-end systems that span device, network, and
server tiers, and comfort reasoning about failure modes across that boundary.

This is an excellent opportunity to forge your career covering the economically and politically influential sector of global energy and commodities. You will apply and develop your skills across daily news reporting, market analysis, features and editorials in this fast-paced environment with the highest standards of journalistic independence and integrity; and there are opportunities to travel and present papers at industry conferences and lead webinar sessions.

**Role**

Argus is seeking a candidate to join the expanding Freight team in London, which covers specialised, tanker, dry bulk and gas freight markets. As a member of this team, you will become familiar with all these markets and an expert in one or more of them, with reporting on the specialised and biofuels freight market being the primary responsibility for this role.

You will cover your market through weekly price assessments, writing interesting, analytical market commentaries as well as an in-depth weekly analysis piece, allowing you to take a wide view of the market. About the Team  
  
OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, commercial, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.  
  
  
  
About the Role  
  
We’re seeking an experienced lawyer to join OpenAI’s EU Policy/Regulatory Legal team. You will own assigned legal matters and workstreams concerning EU and UK AI and digital regulation, prepare practical legal advice, and support engagements with the EU AI Office, other regulators and policymakers. Working with our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory, you will assess regulatory developments, develop legal recommendations and help translate them into action across OpenAI’s products and operations.  
  
  
  
We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer who can work independently, exercise sound judgment in unfamiliar areas, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work while identifying material risks and knowing when to escalate. This individual-contributor role reports to our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory.  
  
  
  
In this role, you will:  
  
- Prepare for and participate in OpenAI’s EU and UK engagements with the European Commission, EU member states, other EU institutions, national regulators and policymakers, including briefing materials and follow-up actions.  
  
- Advise on the interpretation and application of existing and emerging AI, digital and technology regulation, and translate complex regulatory requirements into practical legal and business guidance.  
  
- Assess regulatory developments, enforcement risks and policy proposals, and develop legal recommendations for the AGC on their implications for OpenAI’s products and operations.  
  
- Work with US and EU legal colleagues to deliver coordinated advice and progress assigned cross-border matters.  
  
- Partner with Global Affairs, policy and regulatory affairs colleagues to draft legal input into policy positions, consultation responses, regulatory guidance, codes of practice and industry standards.  
  
- Own assigned workstreams for regulatory inquiries, investigations and supervisory engagements, including drafting responses, coordinating factual inputs and escalating material issues to the AGC.  
  
  
  
You might thrive in this role if you:  
  
- 10+ years of legal experience.  
  
- Law degree (JD, LL.B., or equivalent) and qualification to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction.  
  
- Experience advising on EU or UK technology regulatory matters and independently managing legal workstreams.  
  
- Relevant in-house, law firm and/or government or institutional legal experience.  
  
- Experience analyzing complex legislation and regulations, including technology laws such as the EU AI Act, Data Act, Digital Services Act, Online Safety Act, GDPR or Digital Markets Act, and the ability to develop expertise in new frameworks.  
  
- Familiarity with EU legislative and regulatory processes and the respective roles of EU institutions and national authorities.  
  
- Experience preparing for or participating in engagements with European regulators or policymakers, including drafting clear, accurate submissions and briefing materials.  
  
- Ability to produce clear and concise writing, distilling complex concepts into simple, explainable, and persuasive ideas.  
  
- Ability to work independently on assigned matters, exercise sound judgment and recognize when to escalate material risks or seek specialist input.  
  
- Ability to move between legal analysis, regulatory strategy and practical implementation, and to identify the issues that matter most to the business.  
  
- Ability to manage competing deadlines, coordinate contributions from other teams and take matters through to delivery.  
  
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to give practical advice and influence colleagues without relying on managerial authority.

## Job Description

**Location:** Debden

**About the Team**

The Security Operations team forms part of the Central Operations Directorate. The primary purpose of the team is to ensure the safety and security of all staff, tenants, and visitors, and to protect the Bank’s buildings, assets, and information.

Security Operations is structured to provide operational resilience and flexibility, enabling teams to train, test, and exercise without impacting daily delivery. As the Bank of England is part of the UK’s**Critical National Infrastructure**, and supports the production of Bank of England banknotes, the team maintains strong and effective engagement with law enforcement and external security partners.

The Perimeter Team play an important role in protecting our people, premises, assets and information from internal and external physical security threats. Working collaboratively with colleagues across the Bank, you will help deliver an effective security operation, respond to infrastructure failures and support the safe continuity of our wider operations. This role operates a staggered Monday-to-Friday shift pattern, with early shifts starting at 06:30 and late shifts finishing by 22:30.

**Responsibilities**

* Carry out reception-based security duties in line with established standard operating procedures.
* Conduct external patrols and safeguard Bank documents, IT equipment and safes, responding effectively to security breaches.
* Respond calmly and appropriately to external threats and security concerns, including terrorism, suspicious vehicles or activity, protests, bomb warnings, crime and demonstrations.
* Follow established procedures and escalate concerns to the appropriate teams.
* Help protect life and prevent the loss of assets, critical technology and sensitive information, while safeguarding the Bank’s reputation.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the Bank, its critical systems and business areas to minimise disruption and support operational continuity.
* Take an active role in training, professional development and security exercises.

**Role requirements**

**Minimum criteria**

* Demonstrable knowledge and experience of security guarding.
* Experience of managing conflict effectively and professionally.
* Competence in using IT systems and applications.
* Clear and effective communication skills.
* Experience of carrying out physical security patrols.

**Essential criteria**

* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work confidently with a wide range of stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* The ability to produce clear, accurate and effective written reports.
* Proficiency in using two-way radios.

**Desirable criteria**

* An SIA Door Supervisor or Security Guard licence.
* Previous first-aid response experience or a recognised HSE first-aid qualification.
* Previous security experience within a corporate environment.

***Due to the nature of the Security Officer – Perimeter position, which involves conducting physical security searches on male visitors, there is a genuine occupational requirement for the position holder to be male in accordance with Schedule 9, Part 1 of the Equality Act 2010.***

The Bank values diversity, equity and inclusion. We play a key role in maintaining monetary and financial stability, and to do that effectively, we believe we need a workforce that reflects the society we serve.

**Location:** Debden

### **The Role**

This role leads the EMEA Small to medium and MidMarket business team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the region. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline across multiple countries, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter.

This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works deals alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution in each market, and uses data to drive performance. It is a first-line leader role who has already delivered results in EMEA and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company.

### **Responsibilities**

#### **Deal leadership**

* Engage directly in the team's most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, commercial structure, procurement, legal, DPA, and security review.
* Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer's business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to risk reduction and compliance outcomes that drive European buying decisions (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001).
* Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Coach disciplined excellence and field skills to find, transition and close deals efficiently.
* Work tirelessly in the detail of each customer requirement, enabled by experience and strategic effort, placing Bitwarden in the best position possible to win deals and transfer this knowledge to the team.
* Drive accountability through metrics, motivation, method and effective communication techniques. Be accountable, methodical, pragmatic and foster by example lead from the front.

#### **Outbound pipeline generation**

* Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs, localized by market: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging adapted for country and language.
* Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline.
* Align and drive our message with Marketing, Sales Development, and Channel on programs, including partner-sourced plays, that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate.

#### **MEDDPICC and value-based execution**

* Run MEDDPICC as the team's operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element.
* Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process (including works council, procurement, and data-protection steps), and an honest read on Competition.
* Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on.

#### **Data-driven coaching**

* Own the team's KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) by rep and by market, and act on what they show.
* Identify where each AE is losing ground and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap.
* Run a disciplined operating cadence across time zones: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews.

#### **Team building**

* Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives across EMEA markets, and develop them toward promotion.
* Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement across countries and cultures.
* Work across Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing, to deliver revenue as one team.

### **Requirements**

* 3–5 years of first-line sales leadership in EMEA, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories).
* A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that.
* Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach.
* A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline across more than one EMEA market, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced.
* Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Hubspot & industry tooling for reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance.
* A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals.
* Player-coach, building own pipeline coaching the team through example, including closing and processing, customer excellence.
* Strong intellect, a fast learning curve, and the drive to perform in a high-growth environment with demanding targets.
* Strong command of EMEA buying dynamics, procurement processes, regulatory drivers, and channel/partner models.
* Fluent business English. (Additional languages are beneficial considering the role supports all of EMEA e.g., German, French, Dutch, etc.)
