🤝 Reporting to our Quality Manager

💰 £40-50K + equity

## About Shellworks

Our vision is a world where the products around you don't damage our environment or our health. At Shellworks we're making that a reality by creating high performance plastic-free materials for everyday products.

Our technology Vivomer makes the impossible possible. It's grown by bacteria using fermentation, creating a material that is stable in use but degrades in every environment. Its breakthrough is being dishwasherable and home compostable at the same time.

We've closed our Series A and are working with some of the world's most recognised brands to replace plastic at volume. We're at an inflection point: scaling from proof-of-concept to mass-market production.

## The Role

This is a hands on quality role. You'll make sure every part we ship meets spec, working across our materials, design and manufacturing teams and on factory floors with our partners.

Vivomer is a new material going into products that have to perform like plastic: on shelf, in transit, in the dishwasher and in the hands of consumers. Our customers are some of the world's biggest brands, and they need to trust that every part we ship meets spec.

We're looking for someone who has done quality engineering at a high volume manufacturer and wants to help build it at Shellworks from the ground up. You have an eye for detail and a pragmatic view of which checks really matter.

## Where the focus is today

Making sure every Vivomer part meets spec, at volume.

Quality engineering

* Translate product requirements into test plans and quality plans
* Design in line testing and aesthetic standards with our partners so every part is validated before it ships
* Run measurement system analysis, capability studies and SPC on new and running products
* Review our existing checks regularly: cut the ones that don't add value and add the ones that are missing

Supplier quality

* Support audits and qualification of new manufacturing partners
* Run process qualification for new tools and products at our partners
* Track partner performance and drive corrective actions to closure

Day to day quality

* Run incoming inspection and traceability
* Inspect parts and raise NCRs when they're not up to standard, and decide on rework or rejection
* Train and support the inspectors and technicians at our partners who run the checks we define
* Lead root cause analysis on line issues and customer complaints, and fix them for good

Beyond

* Work with our Quality Manager to select and roll out our quality management system as we scale into production
* Help build our quality procedures, documentation and change control, without the bureaucracy

## Who you are

* 3 to 5 years in quality engineering, ideally at a high volume consumer hardware or packaging manufacturer
* A degree in materials, polymers, mechanical engineering or similar
* You've run quality processes on production lines and taken a product from design through to mature production
* Hands on with metrology, GD&T, SPC, MSA and capability studies
* You've worked with suppliers on the factory floor and know what good looks like
* A structured problem solver: 8D, 5 whys, fishbone
* You understand how a material's behaviour shows up in a finished part
* Excited to build the frontier of how materials are made
* High tolerance for ambiguity, low tolerance for bureaucracy

## What We Offer

🌴 28 days holiday + statutory holidays

👶 12 weeks maternity, 6 weeks paternity, both at full pay

💚 Heka wellbeing allowance: gym, therapy, nutrition, fertility support and more

🩺 Virtual GP with same or next day appointments

# Product Manager Privacy

## Know the rules well enough to know where they stop. Own consent across FastCMP and every Sparteo product on web, app and CTV, lead the Privacy squad and monetize all the traffic the law allows.

## **Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure.**

Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers.  
But we don’t stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, **our mission is to monetize audiences**, across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers **30% higher revenues** for our clients on average than traditional solutions.

Our Solutions:  
→ Actirise: the display tech designed for performance  
→ FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes  
→ Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks  
→ Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution

Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising.

Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe:

* FT1000 ranking: Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025
* The Europas: Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups
* Pixalate Ranking: #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange

These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act.

* **We are Drivers, not passengers:** We take the wheel and own our results.
* **We are data-obsessed:** Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos.
* **We think as one:** Collective goals come before personal wins.
* **We trade off:** We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results.
* **We solve problems:** We own challenges and turn ideas into action.
* **We say what we do:** Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding.

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

##### The Mission

As the **Product Manager Privacy**, you own how every Sparteo product collects, reads and applies consent signals. This covers the engine of FastCMP, our Consent Management Platform (CMP), and every channel that sends these signals to buyers: Actirise, Viously, and our SSP Meetscale on web, app and CTV. You lead the Privacy squad and report to the VP Product.

Your mission: monetize as much traffic as possible within privacy rules. You turn standards and laws into clear product rules. You defend the compliant interpretation that protects our publishers’ revenue, and you never apply a rule more strictly than it requires.

##### Your key responsibilities

**1. Consent Engine & Frameworks**

* Own the roadmap of the FastCMP signal engine: IAB TCF, GPP, GPC (Global Privacy Control), Google Consent Mode and US privacy signals.
* Define jurisdictions: which framework and which default behavior apply in each country.
* Deliver each new standard version on time, on web, app and CTV.

**2. Rules Every Channel Can Apply**

* Translate each standard and each law into product specifications for each channel: Actirise, Viously, Meetscale Web, App and CTV.
* Own the compliance checklist that every consent-related initiative must pass.
* Check with each channel PM that the signal is collected, respected and transmitted correctly.

**3. Monetization Under Privacy Constraints**

* Separate what is mandatory from what is only recommended, and measure the revenue impact of each option before a decision.
* Monetize traffic with no consent or partial consent: legitimate interest, contextual advertising, no-ad rules.
* Apply the rule “measure, decide, apply”: no traffic is rejected or degraded without a measurement and a written decision.

**4. Compliance, Vendors & Certifications**

* Own the IAB TCF and Google CMP certifications, and prevent any risk of deregistration.
* Manage the vendor list and custom vendors.
* Get each interpretation validated by our Data Protection Officer (DPO), who advises but does not decide.

**5. Privacy Point of Contact for Clients & Partners**

* Be the product contact for strategic clients and partners on privacy topics: CMP migrations, regulator requests, buyer requirements.
* Monitor upcoming regulations and standards, and turn them into roadmap items before they become urgent.

**6. Agentic Exposure & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Apply the agentic-first principle: every privacy rule and configuration must be executable by an AI agent, with clean data contracts and proper access controls.
* Work with Engagement (consent templates and A/B tests), UX Orchestration (CMP and paywall configuration), Analytics (signal measurement), FastCMP engineering and the DPO.

##### Your profile for this job

We are looking for someone who knows the rules well enough to know where they stop, and who defends revenue inside that frame.

* **Privacy Expertise:** 5+ years in privacy, CMP or ad tech, including product experience. You have shipped in this ecosystem.
* **Standards Mastery:** IAB TCF, GPP, OpenRTB consent fields, GDPR and ePrivacy, US privacy laws (CCPA and state laws).
* **Business Sense:** You can say “this is not mandatory”, and you prove it with numbers.
* **Technical Literacy:** You do not code, but you write specifications that engineers can apply without back-and-forth.
* **Data-Driven:** You measure before you decide: SQL basics, dashboards, A/B tests.
* **AI Every Day:** You use an AI assistant such as Claude every day, and you have already built skills and agentic workflows in your PM work.
* **Communication:** Comfortable with lawyers and engineers alike. Fluent in English and French.

##### Your mindset to share our adventure

* 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively, building on what works and questioning what can be improved.
* 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.
* ⚡ You’re looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.
* 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

##### Benefits & Work Environment

* 🌍 **Dynamic Remote Culture:** At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our offices in Paris, Lille, or London.
* 🗣️ **English work environment:** English is our working language across teams and countries.
* 🤖 **AI at your fingertips:** Claude is made available to every team member.
* 👥 **Close-knit Team:** Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success.
* 🎉 **Vibrant Social Events:** Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.
* 📈 **Rapid Growth:** Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.
* 🎯 **Tailored Support:** We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and regular performance feedback sessions.
* 🩺 **Comprehensive health coverage:** We provide a robust health insurance plan, ensuring you are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Telford, England, United Kingdom

(Hybrid)

## Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Complaints Analyst to join our Risk and Governance team. If you’re looking for a new challenge with an organisation committed to putting customers first, aiming high and working together, you’ll thrive here.

Job Type:  Permanent

Location: This role is based in our Telford office working 5 days a week from the office initially spent whilst training completes (up to 6 months) then 3 days in the office thereafter and 2 days working from home.

Flexible working: All roles are open to part-time, job-share and other types of flexibility. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.

Salary and benefits: From £33,100 depending on experience plus bonus, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.

Closing date: 5th November

To make things easier, you might want to save this advert now, it won’t be accessible after the closing date.  
  
Who are we?

We’re Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone’s journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we’ve been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.

Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.

The role

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Complaints function at a time of significant transformation and investment in customer outcomes. As a Senior Complaints Analyst, you'll be trusted to investigate some of our most complex and sensitive complaints, helping to ensure we deliver fair outcomes for customers while protecting the business from regulatory and reputational risk.

No two days are the same. You could be leading an investigation into a complex retirement or annuity complaint, preparing a business file for the Financial Ombudsman Service, analysing complaint trends to identify emerging risks, or presenting insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders. You'll work closely with operational teams, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Customer Experience and senior leaders across the business to drive positive customer outcomes and influence meaningful change.

This role offers the opportunity to become a recognised subject matter expert in complaint handling, customer outcomes and Financial Ombudsman Service expectations. You'll play a key role in identifying root causes, influencing process improvements and ensuring lessons learned from complaints result in lasting improvements for both our customers and our business.

If you're someone who enjoys solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders, making decisions that matter and driving continuous improvement, this role offers excellent exposure, variety and development opportunities. You'll have the chance to build strong relationships across the organisation, contribute to governance forums and help shape the future of complaint handling within Standard Life.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage complex and high-profile complaints and escalations, including Executive, CEO, media and regulatory cases, through investigation to resolution in line with FCA requirements and customer outcome expectations.
* Manage Financial Ombudsman Service referrals through to conclusion, acting as a key point of contact and ensuring high-quality case management and business files.
* Deliver fair, timely and evidence-based complaint decisions, applying sound judgement and appropriate support in complex cases, including those involving vulnerable customers.
* Analyse complaint trends and conduct root cause analysis, identifying process failures, control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
* Drive improvements arising from complaint investigations, influencing corrective actions and supporting their implementation and ongoing monitoring.
* Build effective relationships across Operations, Risk, Compliance, Customer Experience and senior stakeholders, providing expert guidance and influencing complaint outcomes and improvements.
* Produce management information, governance reporting and insight, representing the Complaints function at governance forums, working groups and stakeholder meetings.
* Act as a subject matter expert in complaint handling, customer outcomes, vulnerable customers and FOS expectations, coaching and sharing knowledge to build capability across the wider team.

What are we looking for?

Essential

* Strong knowledge and experience of pensions, annuities or wider retirement products, with a thorough understanding of FCA complaint handling requirements and Financial Ombudsman Service processes.
* Experience investigating and resolving complex customer complaints, escalations and regulatory referrals, including sensitive cases involving vulnerable customers.
* Proven analytical and root cause analysis skills, identifying complaint trends, applying sound judgement and identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
* Experience producing high-quality complaint responses, business files and governance reporting, with the ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly.
* Demonstrable stakeholder management and influencing skills, working across multiple business areas to resolve issues and drive customer outcome improvements.
* Strong organisational skills, managing competing priorities, complex cases and tight deadlines.
* Experience contributing to or leading governance forums, working groups and stakeholder discussions.

Desirable

* Experience managing Financial Ombudsman Service referrals and Executive or CEO complaints.
* Quality assurance, regulatory oversight or complaint governance experience.

# **About** **Super.com**

We started Super.com to help maximize lives–both the lives of our customers and the lives of our team – so that everyone can experience all that life has to offer. For our employees, our promise is that Super.com is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to unlock one’s potential, where learning is celebrated and impact is realized.

We are more than a fast-paced, high-growth tech company; we care about our people and take career progression seriously. This is your career and our aim is to supercharge it through the people, the work, and the programs that fuel who we are.

# **About the role**

Payments at Super.com spans two business models with different mechanics. Our travel business runs high-value one-time transactions with authorization holds, delayed capture, and cancellation driven disputes. Our subscription business runs recurring billing, where retry logic, credential lifecycle, and involuntary churn drive the numbers. You will own both.

This is an individual contributor role. You will be the lead of the payments MAT (mission-aligned team): running the team’s planning and day-to-day execution against the payments roadmap, and leading it through clarity, credibility, and influence rather than reporting lines.

The role will report to the Director of Product and work closely with the Head of Payments, who sets the overall payments strategy and roadmap. Fraud prevention sits with a separate department, and disputes sits with a dedicated disputes function. You will partner with both, as routing, authorization rate, and 3DS decisions cut across all three.

# **About the team**

This role sits on the Product team at Super.com. We operate as a cross-functional, mission-aligned team (MAT), partnering with engineering, product, data, and commercial leaders to provide best in class payments experiences to our customers and partners, while increasing the likelihood of positive, profitable transactions. The MAT is made up primarily of engineers, along with a technical account manager.

# **What you’ll be working on:**

* **Contribute to the payments roadmap.** Work with the Head of Payments on the roadmap for your area, and own prioritization of the MAT’s backlog within it. Bring data-backed recommendations when you see an opportunity to change course.
* **Write the requirements.** PRDs and business requirements that engineers can build from, covering failure paths, reconciliation impact, and explicit scope boundaries.
* **Lead the payments MAT day to day.** Run the team’s planning and rituals, keep the backlog prioritized against the roadmap, and be the team’s main point of contact for stakeholders. Partner with the engineering manager, who owns engineering execution and the engineers themselves.
* **Drive delivery.** Sequence work, remove blockers, and manage scope within the agreed roadmap, escalating tradeoffs that change priorities or timelines to the Head of Payments.
* **Improve routing and authorization performance.** Run routing and retry experiments, evaluate the results, and recommend changes.
* **Support payments market entry** as we expand internationally, researching local payment method coverage and writing requirements for new-market launches, in partnership with the Head of Payments.
* **Use data to recommend improvements.** Analyze authorization rates, decline patterns, cost per transaction, and settlement performance, and bring recommendations to the team and the Head of Payments.
* **Contribute to monthly payments reporting** for Finance, covering delivery, performance against targets, and upcoming priorities.
* **Track industry and regulatory change** (e.g., SCA, network rules, APM adoption) and flag its impact on your roadmap.

# **What we’re looking for:**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, including 1+ year working on payments, fintech, checkout, or billing products.
* Working knowledge of a modern payments stack, including gateways, processors and acquirers, tokenization, and alternative payment methods.
* Understanding of one-time payment mechanics (authorization holds, delayed capture, settlement) or recurring billing mechanics (dunning, retries, credential-on-file), with curiosity to learn the other.
* A track record of shipping. You have shipped features end to end with engineering, from requirements through launch.
* Product craft. You write clear requirements, you can explain the reasoning behind a prioritization decision, and you are disciplined about scope.
* Technical and data fluency sufficient to work closely with engineers, understand technical tradeoffs, and analyze performance data.
* Comfortable coordinating a cross-functional team and keeping work moving without formal authority, and knowing when to escalate.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can communicate clearly with engineers and stakeholders.
* Resourceful and self-directed. You can manage shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.

# **Bonus points for:**

* Exposure to payments launches in new markets, particularly in APAC, EEA or LATAM.
* Experience in high-volume consumer businesses, and familiarity with marketplace, travel, or e-commerce payment flows.
* Exposure to disputes and chargeback data.

**Job Purpose:**

As a Quality Auditor (Intake), you’ll play a key role in ensuring that all raw material deliveries, including packaging, meet company and customer specifications. You’ll carry out inspections and testing on incoming materials, identify any non-conformities, and liaise directly with suppliers to drive investigations and ensure issues are resolved effectively. Your work will help maintain the highest standards of quality, food safety and compliance from the very start of the production process.

**Key Duties, Responsibilities & Accountabilities:**

•   Manage the receipt of raw materials and packaging, ensuring all deliveries comply with approved specifications, artwork and QAS requirements, and that all required certifications and supporting documentation meet agreed standards.

•   Ensure samples are booked onto the laboratory portal and dispatched to the appropriate laboratory for testing. Review and assess results before releasing materials, and promptly report, investigate and action any out-of-specification results.

•   Inspect incoming packaging against approved standards, specifications and artwork requirements before authorising its release for use.

•   Conduct and document temperature verification checks for products and the relevant production or storage environments, escalating any results outside defined limits.

•   Conduct CCP verification activities relevant to the area being worked in, accurately record findings and promptly report any non-conformances for appropriate corrective action.

•   Participate in regulatory, certification and customer audits, supporting audit preparation, providing relevant evidence and assisting with the timely completion of any resulting corrective actions.

•   Conduct scheduled calibration and verification checks on relevant equipment, accurately record the results and escalate any equipment found to be outside acceptable tolerances.

# **Residential Facilities Manager**

## **Purpose of Role**

At The Crown Estate, we take a long-term approach to creating value and positive outcomes for the people, places and environments connected to our portfolio.

As 'Residential Facilities Manager', you will deliver high-quality facilities management across our residential portfolio. You will help ensure our buildings and communal areas are safe, compliant and maintained to a consistently high standard, supporting an excellent experience for residents.

Working collaboratively with Property Managers, Block Managers, Hard Services colleagues and the wider Portfolio Operations team, you will oversee day-to-day hard and soft services. * Maintaining effective emergency and incident-response arrangements, including out-of-hours readiness.
* Working with Property Managers and Block Managers to align operational delivery with asset plans and identify emerging risks, issues and opportunities.
* Maintaining statutory, regulatory, health and safety, fire safety and building safety compliance.
* Preparing and managing service charge budgets for hard and soft services, supporting financial reporting, cost control and value for money.

* Supporting sustainability objectives and embedding environmental, social and governance principles into day-to-day operations.
* Working collaboratively across teams and role-modelling professional, respectful and inclusive behaviours.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

* Proven facilities management experience within a residential or mixed-use environment.
* A strong understanding of residential building operations, statutory compliance, health and safety, fire safety and building safety requirements.
* Experience managing contractors and service partners to deliver consistent, high-quality operational outcomes.
* Experience managing planned and reactive maintenance, compliance, operational risk and audit-ready records.
* Strong customer service and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with residents, colleagues, consultants and service partners.

* The ability to manage multiple priorities, respond effectively to high-pressure situations and solve problems proactively.

* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a commitment to high operational standards.
* Sound professional judgement, integrity and a collaborative approach.

# Level Designer

### Level designers lay out the spaces a game is played in and tune how they read, how they flow and how hard they are.

A level designer builds the playable space: the layout of an area, the route a player takes through it, the placement of encounters, cover, pickups and the signposting that makes all of it readable. The work starts in blockout, where only volumes and distances exist, and ends after many rounds of playtesting, where pacing and difficulty are adjusted against what players actually do rather than what the plan assumed.

Most of the job happens inside an editor. Postings ask for scripting of events and triggers, visual scripting such as Blueprints, world building across connected areas, and enough technical care to keep an area inside its performance budget.

The neighbouring roles split along two lines. A level artist dresses and lights the space the level designer has laid out; a game designer owns the rules and systems the space is built around. Level design sits between them and answers for the experience of moving through the world.

We're building a new product from scratch: a password and authentication manager.
Logging in is one of the most frustrating parts of everyone's digital life, which is why most people still reuse the same password everywhere. We think there's room for something that's genuinely simple to use, protects people before they get breached, and is built for a world of passkeys and AI agents.

## Description

**Location:** Fully Remote, UK

**Reports to:** Product Manager for Core Content

### **About Vable**

**Vable** builds content intelligence software used by international law firms, consultancies and government teams. We help organisations turn information overload into competitive advantage.

Our clients rely on Vable to monitor thousands of trusted sources: the news sites, publisher feeds and email newsletters through which we track content for them daily. That only works if those sources are accurate, healthy and set up properly. Keeping them that way takes careful, hands-on work, and we need someone to help us do it well.

### **The Role**

We are hiring a **Content Operations Specialist** to keep our source library accurate and reliable for clients. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension.

You will work alongside our Data Specialist, setting up new sources and keeping existing ones working. Much of the job is hands-on: checking web pages and emails, working out why a source has stopped collecting content, and fixing it using our existing processes.

This is a small team of two, so your work makes a visible difference every day. The tasks are detailed, and much of it is about responding quickly to issues as they come up. No two days are quite the same: one day you might work through dozens of source checks, the next you might help deliver a large project for a client. This won't be a client-facing role, but client requests will come to you through our Customer Success team. If you love a system that runs like clockwork, and get a buzz from tracking down a problem and putting it right before anyone else notices, read on.

### **What You'll Do**

* Set up new sources for clients
* Investigate and fix broken sources with the help of our internal tools, for example by reading a page's HTML, checking HTTP errors, or using XPath to extract relevant information
* Carry out daily source maintenance, keeping error levels within our quality targets and fixing issues before clients notice them
* Maintain publisher records, including name updates
* Escalate wider issues to the Product Manager
* Support client requests, from quick checks to migrations and bulk source projects
* Take part in the maintenance projects we run at set points in the year to find hidden problems across our content
* Share feedback on which parts of our tools and processes are slow or awkward, so we can improve them
* Your work should show up in source health, fewer client-reported issues and faster turnaround on client requests.

### **Is This You?**

Accuracy matters to you, whether at work or in your studies. You get real satisfaction from a system that runs smoothly, and when something looks slightly off, you want to know why and fix it.

You do your best work when you can settle in and focus. You like working at pace, moving from one problem to the next, and you enjoy the rhythm of fixing things in quick succession.

You might come from operations, data quality, research, library or information services, or a support role where you got deep into the data. You might also be a recent graduate. You don't need to be highly technical already: we will teach you how to read a page's HTML and use XPath to fix sources. What matters is that you are curious about how things work and pick up new tools quickly.

### **Essential Criteria**

* 2+ years in a detail-focused role, such as data quality, operations, research or support
* Excellent attention to detail, and the patience to do a high volume of similar checks to a consistently high standard
* The ability to learn quickly, and curiosity about how websites and tools work
* Ownership of your work: you see tasks through, prioritise without close direction and flag problems early
* Clear written communication, especially when explaining an issue to colleagues
* Familiarity with HTML or XPath is a plus
* The right to live and work in the UK

### **Desirable Criteria**

* Comfortable working closely with Customer Success and Product teams
* Experience in a fully remote technical environment

### Why Join?

This is a role for problem solvers who like to see results. When you fix a source, content starts flowing to clients again straight away. You will have real responsibility from your first weeks and learn quickly alongside a small team that knows the work inside out. By the end of your contract, you'll be able to cover the content function on your own.

We are investing in better tools and processes for this work, and your day-to-day feedback will help decide what we improve first.

### You're Probably Not the Right Fit If:

* You find detailed, repetitive checking draining rather than satisfying
* You would rather wait to be told what to fix than go looking for problems, or you tend to push on alone rather than speak up when you're stuck
* You are looking for a role focused on strategy rather than hands-on delivery
* You like the social aspect of corridor chats and time talking face to face. We have plenty of social interaction, but it is remote.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

🟢 **First 30 Days:** Confident with our sources, publishers and tools, handling day-to-day maintenance and requests with support

🟢 **First 90 Days:** Setting up and fixing sources independently, with proactive source-health checks back on a regular rhythm

🟢 **By 6 Months:** Taking on migrations and bulk projects without disruption, and able to cover the content function on your own

### **What We Offer:**

Remote-first flexibility, WFH and learning budgets. More than that, a supportive team.

***We're a team that takes ownership, stays curious, succeeds as a team and treats each other well with kindness and empathy. That's not a values statement, it's just how we work 💚***

**Ready to Apply?**

Submit your CV, cover letter and answers to the application questions. The process runs over 2-3 weeks and has three stages: an intro call with our People team, then an interview with the Product Manager for Core Content and another applicable Vabler. Final candidates will have a short conversation with our Head of Product before an offer is made.

## Job Description

Vizrt is looking for a Salesforce Product Owner to take genuine end-to-end ownership of the Salesforce platform — not just the roadmap and backlog, but the business outcomes that roadmap is meant to deliver. This is a senior, business-facing role for someone able to define what “good” looks like for the platform, defend that definition against competing stakeholder demands, and see it through to delivery via an offshore development team. Agentforce is imminent on our platform, and this role will shape how AI-enabled features — including agentic capability in Sales and Service — make their way onto the roadmap responsibly.

This role sits deliberately close to delivery: the successful candidate will own outcome definition and acceptance criteria personally, while translation into detailed, implementation-ready user stories is carried out in partnership with an offshore delivery lead. The Product Owner is accountable for delivery of the roadmap and holds formal or, at minimum, strong influence-based authority — backed by a named escalation path — over prioritisation of the offshore delivery lead’s work, so that accountability is matched by real authority.

***Outcome ownership & roadmap***

•       Define and own the Salesforce product roadmap in terms of the business outcomes it is intended to deliver (e.g. adoption, process efficiency, revenue enablement) — not just the list of features being built.

•       Set and defend prioritisation of the roadmap and backlog against competing demands from Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service, making trade-off calls rather than simply relaying stakeholder requests.

•       Define acceptance criteria and success measures for each roadmap item in outcome terms (e.g. adoption rate, cycle time, business KPI movement), not just delivery/completion status.

***Delivery accountability***

•       Hold end-to-end accountability for delivery of the roadmap, including through the offshore development team.

•       Hold formal or influence-based authority — with a committed escalation and resolution path — over the offshore delivery lead’s priorities, to reprioritise work when roadmap needs shift or delivery is at risk.

Amazon Security is responsible for the protection of customer and corporate data. We are connected to all parts of Amazon's business and its massive, worldwide service-oriented architecture. We are looking for a Software Development Engineers who are excited about leading the technical vision and architecture for innovative, mission critical software security systems that affect how Amazon developers create and deploy software that is secure and protects Amazon's and our customers data.
Key job responsibilities
You will work with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that will influence the Amazon developer experience. Your first mission is to build a new product that leverages application meta data from a variety of sources to synthesize in a human readable way a variety of application knowledge. This will require rapid iteration with a variety of software and security teams. Since our security systems are foundational to the Amazon ecosystem, you will also have the opportunity to learn about various Amazon business including the Amazon e-Commerce websites, Prime, Alexa, and AWS.
We're looking for a creative, customer- and details-obsessed Software Development Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals (object-oriented design, algorithms and data structures) and a good grasp of advanced systems concepts and design. You must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven and be able to deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You need to enjoy working closely with your peers of very talented engineers.
A day in the life
You'll solve complex challenges by designing and implementing scalable solutions that protect Amazon's customers and systems. You'll work with security engineering teams to transform domain expertise into software that mitigates risks at unprecedented scale. In a typical day, you might:
• Develop code that reduces manual security processes by 50% or more, enabling our teams to respond faster and more effectively
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate intricate security requirements into elegant, high-performance software solutions
• Prototype and implement security tools that protect millions of customers and billions in transactions
You'll work in an environment that values rapid innovation, where your ideas can move from concept to production in weeks, not months. Your work directly impacts Amazon's ability to maintain the highest standards of customer trust and system resilience.

This team will work with local and international security teams to design a greenfield product that solves the complex problem of rapidly knowing critical security details about every Amazon application. This team of problem solvers is heavily customer obsessed with a leaning toward rapid prototyping and implementation.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Teams
Our Data Enrichment team builds the ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe complex driving scenes across Wayve's data corpus. Drawing on Wayve's World Foundation Model, we help teams find rare scenarios, expose performance gaps and develop better perception and driving models, supporting the safety and reliability of Wayve's ADAS and AI Driver products. As a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Enrichment, you will tackle computer vision problems spanning road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour.

• Work with internal customers to define scene and scenario attributes, dataset requirements and measurable acceptance criteria for annotations and classifiers
• Design and refine annotation tasks and labelling instructions, using pilots, annotator agreement and expert review to resolve ambiguity and measure quality
• Curate and deliver ground-truth datasets for other teams to train and evaluate models, addressing rare scenarios, class imbalance and coverage across countries and vehicle platforms
• Build and evaluate computer vision models that draw on Wayve's World Foundation Model to identify scene attributes and driving behaviours
• Use error analysis to identify gaps in data, labels and model performance, and test approaches to improve them

• Ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour

• Improving reusable tools for annotation, training, evaluation and inference
• Documenting dataset and classifier quality, and communicating limitations to colleagues across disciplines

Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks.

We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you.

This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington.

* Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring.

* Develop localisation-aware path planning, waypoint execution and obstacle handling, working with project and site teams to turn work plans and BIM-derived locations into robot missions.
* Integrate capture payloads so images, pose, timing and mission status flow reliably into XYZ’s construction progress workflows, working with navigation, SLAM and perception colleagues.
* Design test scenarios and measure mission completion, coverage, localisation quality, intervention, recovery and repeatability, improving the system through measured iterations.
* Bring technical expertise and new ideas to the programme, comparing scripted, motion-planning and learning-based approaches and helping shape what comes next.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MSc or PhD in Robotics, Controls, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent applied robotics experience. Industry experience is not required.
* Hands-on experience building, programming or directly controlling a physical robot, from an academic project, research lab or industry.
* Strong Python and C++, practical ROS experience (ideally ROS 2) and working knowledge of kinematics, coordinate frames, feedback control, state estimation, path planning and robot hardware.
* Experience training or tuning robot control policies (e.g. reinforcement or imitation learning) using NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim or similar tools, with a rigorous experimental approach.
* The right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

**KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* ROS / ROS 2, Python & C++
* Robot control, kinematics, state estimation & path planning
* NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim, reinforcement or imitation learning
* Sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware (desirable)
* Navigation, SLAM, perception & sensor fusion (desirable)
* Mobile or field robotics, BIM/CAD or construction technology (desirable)
